meta.description: Machine-readable regulation constants for Landsight's planting-code checks. Every constant carries its citation. Transcribed from the regulation texts and sources read 2026-11-01/02.
meta.jurisdiction_note: National rules apply everywhere. Some municipalities add stricter rules (the 'municipal_reference' section, a reference set of one municipality's greening rule and tree protection ordinance). For the sample site no municipal greening rule applies; national rules are assumed, as in docs/PLAN.md. The site's municipal tree protection ordinance is in 'municipal' (below).
meta.disclaimer: Reference data for a review tool. The registered architect signs off the code calculation (D-05).

glossary.綠化總固碳當量 TCO2: total carbon fixation equivalent of greening (kgCO2e/yr)
glossary.固碳當量 Gi: carbon fixation equivalent per unit planted area of a plant type
glossary.固碳當量基準值 β: baseline carbon fixation equivalent per m2 of minimum green area, by land-use class
glossary.執行綠化有困難之面積 Ap: area where greening is impracticable, only as the architect declares it under §299 (for example fire-truck rescue space the fire authority recognises, arcades, site roads, sports fields); 0 unless declared
glossary.原生或誘鳥誘蝶植物採用比值 ra: share of native or bird/butterfly-attracting trees, by tree count
glossary.草花花圃/自然野草地/水生植物/草坪: flower beds / meadow / aquatic plants / lawn
glossary.生態複層: ecological multi-layer planting (trees, shrubs and groundcover mixed, tree spacing <= 3.5 m)
glossary.人工地盤: artificial ground (roof, balcony, terrace, facade, podium slab)
glossary.老樹: old tree (米高徑 >= 30 cm or age >= 20 yr)
glossary.米高徑: trunk diameter measured 1 m above ground
glossary.綠覆率: green coverage ratio (green-cover area / legal open space) - municipal greening rule
glossary.綠容率: green volume ratio (equivalent green-cover area / site area) - municipal greening rule
glossary.法定空地: legal open space (site area x (1 - coverage ratio))

artificial_ground.description: Minimum soil depth and tree-pit area per plant type. Planting that misses these is not counted (§5: 植栽之覆土深度與最小樹穴面積必須合乎表1之規定始得承認之).
artificial_ground.column_note: Table 1 has two soil-depth columns: 屋頂、陽臺、露臺、建築立面 (roof, balcony, terrace, facade) and 其他 (other ground). The text does not name a podium over a basement (地下室頂板); treat it as 'needs review' and show both depths. The municipal greening rule, Arts 8-9, does cover podiums (see municipal_reference.soil_depth).

water_retention_spec.description: Site water-retention index λ = Q′ / Q0 must exceed λc; Q′ (the sum of the retention items, at most Q0) and Q0 = A0 × f × t.
water_retention_spec.lambda_c: 0.5 × (1 − r) for an ordinary building site (0.5 for a whole school campus); r capped at 0.85

items.Q1: Q1 = A1 · f · t — green space, covered ground, grass swales (natural ground: nothing built below, no paving above)
items.Q2: Q2 = 0.5 · A2 · f · t + 0.05 · h · A2 (interlocking unit pavers); 0.5 · A2 · f · t + 0.3 · h · A2 (vented structure); h = graded base thickness ≤ 0.25 m; Q2 = 0 when the base is concrete or another impervious layer
items.Q3: Q3 = 0.05 · V3 — garden soil on artificial ground (roofs, balconies, ground over a basement); V3 counts soil depth up to 0.6 m

water_retention_spec.f_note: f from an infiltration test or the soil within 2 m of the surface (tables 2 and 3); fill soil takes 1e-5 m/s (table 2, note 1)
water_retention_spec.applies_to: new buildings, except hillside sites (chapter 13), groundwater shallower than 1 m, individually built farmhouses and sites of 300 m² or less

cite.source: 建築基地保水設計技術規範修正規定 (Technical Specification for Building-Site Water Retention Design)
